review_notes: I read the whole file. The only definition is `Multiset.fold`, which is defined as `foldr op`. It is a named specialisation of `Multiset.foldr` for operations that are commutative and associative. `foldr` is in Mathlib/Data/Multiset/MapFold.lean and needs only `LeftCommutative`. The file connects the two with `fold_eq_foldr`, `fold_eq_foldl` and `coe_fold_l`. `fold` is used in Finset.fold and in several other files, so it is not a competing parallel concept. The theorems are standalone lemmas, which the rubric excludes. The `Std.Commutative` and `Std.Associative` hypotheses come from core. I found no independent duplicate definition, so I am abstaining. I did not search every possible competing notion exhaustively, for example prod and sum as folds, but those are built on top of this API rather than duplicating it.
